name: Caglar Gulcehre
lab: Caglar Gulcehre Lab for AI Research (CLAIRE)
one_sentence_summary: Caglar Gulcehre leads CLAIRE at EPFL, researching efficient deep learning spanning reinforcement learning, large language model training, sequence modeling architectures (RNNs/Transformers/SSMs/diffusion), AI safety/alignment, and system-2 reasoning.
matrix_summary: CLAIRE has two notable new developments: **RAT+** (Recurrence Augmented Attention+) was accepted at **ICML 2026**, showing a single densely pre-trained model can achieve up to 64× inference-time attention sparsity with minimal accuracy loss at 7.6B scale. Additionally, a new preprint **"Loopholing All the Way" (LAW)** proposes a pure self-conditioning language model that outperforms prior diffusion LMs on reasoning tasks and approaches autoregressive models on text generation.
